_comment: Shadow-strategy registry. Default-off: every entry must have global_enabled=false. A shadow strategy evaluates blocked-gate slices as research-only counterfactuals. It does NOT submit orders. Promotion to paper or live requires (1) sample size >= min_n, (2) profit factor >= promotion_pf_threshold sustained over rolling window, (3) ledger entry + signed approval. See ops/research/mtf_long_support_shadow_eval.py and project_real_money_boundary.md.

shadow_strategies.notes: Codex audit 2026-05-08 found this slice positive on n=13. Per project_real_money_boundary.md, NEVER promote shadow-only into live without (a) min_n=50 reached, (b) PF holds >=1.30 over the rolling window, (c) ledger entry signed by approver.
